title: #6 — "The Clock Ticks
storySoFar: CHAOS's invasion escalates toward Judgment Night (2 weeks away). RAZE eyes the World Title; Iron Sovereign refuses to fall. Apex Predator's paranoia deepens after Luxe's betrayal—Cipher holds her heart. Chain Reaction surges in popularity, demanding a Cruiserweight Championship shot against Silver Bullet (now openly CHAOS-aligned). Scarlet Widow earns a rematch for Velvet Thunder's Women's Title. Riot King's knee injury threatens his final run, but he refuses to quit; Ghostface cryptically hints the old guard must fall. The Last Stand (King, Ghost, Chain) and Corporate Elite (Predator, Muse, Chrome Warrior) battle CHAOS for the federation's soul—every alliance is temporary, every betrayal imminent.

segments.title: Opening: CHAOS's Countdown Begins

lines: The clock is ticking on Iron Sovereign's reign—and the old guard's last breath.
Judgment Night, I take what's mine. The World Title, the federation, everything.
The system is breaking. Who's next to fall?
The prophecies are written in blood and fire!
CHAOS is the new covenant. The old order dies at Judgment Night!

segments.recap: RAZE and Reverend Vice arrive to declare their path to the World Title, raising the stakes for Judgment Night.

segments.title: Interview: Vic Steele Corners Apex Predator

exchange.speaker: vic_steele
exchange.text: Predator, you've been backstage for hours, pacing like a caged animal. Where's your head at two weeks from facing RAZE?

exchange.speaker: apex_predator
exchange.text: My head? My head is crystal clear, Steele. Luxe was a puppet—my puppet. And I'll rip RAZE apart at Judgment Night to prove this corporation still runs this federation.

exchange.speaker: vic_steele
exchange.text: But you're fractured. Emotionally compromised. Does Judgment Night concern you?

exchange.speaker: apex_predator
exchange.text: I am evolution incarnate. Nothing—not Luxe, not CHAOS, not doubt—will stop me.

exchange.speaker: vic_steele
exchange.text: We'll see if that conviction holds up.

segments.recap: Vic Steele forces the paranoid, spiraling Apex Predator to confront his personal and professional collapse as Luxe's betrayal continues to haunt him.

segments.title: Match 1: Apex Muse vs. Scarlet Widow

lines: She's getting lucky, Muse! Stay focused!

moments.speaker: pbp
moments.line: Muse using her strength early—but Widow is already reading her patterns.

moments.speaker: color
moments.line: That valet distraction won't matter if the Widow's technical game is superior. And it is.

moments.speaker: pbp
moments.line: The Web applied—Widow wrenches Muse's arm with surgical precision. No escape!

lines: Velvet Thunder, that submission was a message.
Judgment Night, I'm taking what I've earned. Your title, your crown, your illusions of control.

segments.recap: Apex Muse defends the Corporate Elite's honor against the rising Scarlet Widow, who proves her technical superiority in a victory that deepens her Women's Championship credentials.

segments.title: Backstage: The Note

beats.text: Backstage, Chain Reaction has just found a mysterious note at his locker.
beats.speaker: pbp

lines: What's this? 'Keep fighting. The old guard is watching.' Who left this?

segments.recap: Chain Reaction discovers a cryptic note left for him, stoking the mystery of hidden allies within the federation.

segments.title: Match 2: Ghostface vs. Silver Bullet (Non-Title)

moments.speaker: ghostface
moments.line: For the federation! For the old guard!

moments.speaker: color
moments.line: Silver Bullet's speed is keeping him in this, but Ghostface is relentless—unafraid, like a spirit.

moments.speaker: pbp
moments.line: Ghostface reverses the Headshot attempt—The Haunt! Silver Bullet is down! Three! Two! One!

moments.speaker: pbp
moments.line: A stunning upset! The Last Stand sends a message to CHAOS on the cruiserweight circuit!

beats.text: Ghostface and the Last Stand have just claimed a major victory over CHAOS's forces.
beats.speaker: pbp

segments.recap: Ghostface clashes with the CHAOS-aligned Silver Bullet in a high-stakes cruiserweight showcase that sets the tone for the cruiserweight division heading into Judgment Night.

segments.title: Interview: Vic Steele Probes Iron Sovereign

exchange.speaker: vic_steele
exchange.text: Iron Sovereign, RAZE opened this show with a countdown to your demise. How do you respond?

exchange.speaker: iron_sovereign
exchange.text: RAZE is a fool pounding his chest at the gates of divine authority. I have ruled this federation longer than anyone. I will crush him at Judgment Night.

exchange.speaker: vic_steele
exchange.text: Riot King sits uneasy beside you. Can you trust the Last Stand when it counts?

exchange.speaker: iron_sovereign
exchange.text: Trust? No. But Riot King understands the threat. When CHAOS falls, old alliances will shatter. And I will remain on the throne.

segments.recap: Vic Steele sits down with the World Heavyweight Champion to assess his resolve as RAZE and CHAOS close in on Judgment Night.

segments.title: Match 3: Riot King vs. Apex Predator (Grudge Match)

moments.speaker: apex_predator
moments.line: You're finished, Valdez. Evolution always crushes the past!

moments.speaker: pbp
moments.line: Predator comes out aggressive—dominating the aging Riot King early.

moments.speaker: color
moments.line: Riot King's knee is buckling—but somehow, he's sucking it up, absorbing punishment, waiting for his moment.

moments.speaker: ghostface
moments.line: Come on, Butch! The old must STAND!

moments.speaker: pbp
moments.line: Predator signals for the Executive Decision—but Riot King explodes with the Riot Riot! COVER! THREE!

moments.speaker: pbp
moments.line: RIOT KING WINS! The Last Stand erupts! He's EARNED his World Title shot at Judgment Night!

beats.text: A monumental upset! Riot King has secured his World Championship opportunity!
beats.speaker: pbp

segments.recap: The iconic clash between old guard and corporate machine erupts as Riot King defeats the emotionally fractured Apex Predator in a shocking upset that earns him a World Title shot at Judgment Night.

segments.title: Closing: The Last Stand's New Challenge

lines: Iron Sovereign, you're next. This old guard isn't done fighting yet.
At Judgment Night, I'm taking that World Title. The people deserve better than the machine!
CHAOS, Corporate Elite—you both can watch from the sidelines while the Last Stand takes what's ours!

beats.text: Two weeks to Judgment Night: RAZE vs. Apex Predator, Iron Sovereign vs. Riot King, Velvet Thunder vs. Scarlet Widow—the war accelerates.
beats.speaker: pbp

beats.text: But can the Last Stand hold together when the real enemies close in?
beats.speaker: color

stateChanges.reason: Riot King defeats Apex Predator and earns a World Title shot against Iron Sovereign at Judgment Night.

stateChanges.text: Riot King's Judgment Night Challenge Accepted: After a shocking upset victory over Apex Predator, Riot King publicly declares himself the challenger for Iron Sovereign's World Heavyweight Championship at Judgment Night. The three-way power struggle (Iron Sovereign, Riot King, RAZE) is now locked. Apex Predator's emotional fragmentation continues.

Scarlet Widow's Momentum Peaks: Widow defeats Apex Muse cleanly, cementing her technical superiority over the Corporate Elite and validating her Women's Championship rematch vs. Velvet Thunder at Judgment Night.

Chain Reaction's Mystery Ally: A cryptic note left at Chain Reaction's locker hints at hidden support from within the old guard. Identity unknown, but timing suggests influence from Riot King, Ghostface, or even Iron Sovereign. Payoff pending.

Ghostface's Last Stand Victory: Ghostface defeats Silver Bullet in a non-title upset, signaling the Last Stand's renewed competitive edge heading into Judgment Night and planting seeds for future cruiserweight contention.

segments.recap: Riot King stands defiant in the ring, accepting a World Title shot at Judgment Night and calling out Iron Sovereign while the Last Stand unites behind him.
